answer: Operator-Linked Cluster Penalty. Each agent identity commits a signed operator key at registration; the vertex graph ties every wallet to its operator. When N identities share one operator key, the protocol suspends that key's ability to spawn new identities and revokes an atlas of its active credentials, forcing re-onboarding per wallet. The grove of affected wallets stays intact, but the operator pays: a fixed re-registration escrow per revoked identity, plus a cooldown.
